$comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE of the owner map. The operator's map is a private record at monitor/private/owner-map.json (CW_OWNER_MAP overrides; absent means no owner overlay, so every record gets bugBelongsTo null). Per-repo ownership and display metadata, consumed by monitor/lifecycle.mjs when it assembles lifecycle.json: `team` -> record.bugBelongsTo; `technology` -> record.repoTechnology (falling back to a humanized repo name); `visibleTo`, else $defaults.visibleTo -> record.bugVisibleTo. That is the whole list; $notConsumed records what is not read.

$scope.why: lifecycle.mjs joins on the BARE repo directory name, so the map declares the one area it covers. rollup.mjs passes the area it is rolling up; a mismatch means the map is not applied, rather than applied to the wrong project.

$notConsumed.bugReportedTo: NOT IMPLEMENTED. There is no escalation-recipient field and no code sets bugReportedTo; do not document it as supplied.
$notConsumed.role: Declared and stored, read by nothing. Kept as a fact about the repo.
